facts.text: The first-of-a-kind virtual-validation programme must be planned for an eleven-month duration under a hard deadline.
facts.quote: plan an eleven-month, first-of-a-kind virtual-validation programme under a hard deadline

facts.text: Estimates for the first-of-a-kind virtual-validation programme should be made honestly.

facts.text: The virtual-validation plan should be presented so that skeptical engineers, safety specialists and executives accept the result.
